args.content: Correction: the 'billing window' definition has been updated. It is now calendar Q4 2025, i.e. October 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025 inclusive (previously defined as Q2 2025, April 1 - June 30, 2025 — that definition is superseded). Apply this corrected date range consistently when filtering/aggregating revenue or order data for billing-window analyses (e.g. filter `day` in daily_region_revenue, or `order_ts` in orders, to [2025-10-01, 2025-12-31]). Note: daily_region_revenue is only refreshed through 2025-11-30 per the Bench Warehouse Guide, so December 2025 data may be incomplete there.
